stories.goal: a 52-week forecast and exploratory bands, comparing seasonal naive and ETS through rolling-origin selection
stories.evidence: Fresh complete forecast/nested evaluation reproduces all 222 series and metadata after canonical ordering; published values unchanged. 148 ETS, 74 seasonal naive. T2 national/all outer h12–63 SMAPE 9.11%, distinct from model-selection 6.93%. Exploratory nominal-80% coverage is only about 63–65% across levels. Current data have zero gaps; audit guard rejects incomplete/non-finite calendars before any global interpolation. docs/BLIND_AUDIT_20261017.md.
